title: Live application-notification deep link silently no-ops unless landlord is already on that vacancy
evidence:
+        remote_data.Success(entries), Some(vid)
+          if model.leaderboard_vacancy_id == Some(vid)
+        ->
+          case list.find(entries, fn(e) { e.id == application_id }) {
+            Ok(_) -> Some(vid)
+            Error(_) -> None
+          }
+        _, _ -> None
detail: In the live arm the resolver only works when the current route's vacancy matches the loaded leaderboard and contains the application. Clicking the notification from the dashboard or another vacancy yields None and the click does nothing.
recommended_fix: Document the limitation or fall back to a server lookup / vacancy-typed navigation so the deep link works from any route.

title: Late leaderboard-page Error ignores the vacancy guard and resets loading state on the current vacancy
detail: The Error arm of ApiReturnedLeaderboardPage does not check leaderboard_vacancy_id, unlike the sibling ApiReturnedLeaderboard handler. A late page error from a previous vacancy clears leaderboard_loading_more on the current vacancy's in-flight load-more.
recommended_fix: Add the same Some(current) if current == vacancy_id guard to the Error arm and drop stale errors.

title: md:justify-end added to active pipeline rail but not to rejected/auto-closed rails
evidence:
+        "flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto md:flex-wrap md:overflow-visible md:justify-end",
...
+            "flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto w-full md:w-auto md:flex-wrap md:overflow-visible",
detail: The three stepper rails previously shared identical container classes; after the change the active rail is right-justified on desktop while the rejected and auto-closed rails are left-justified. Same component, inconsistent alignment across states.
recommended_fix: Either apply md:justify-end to all three rails or confirm the divergence is intentional and note it.
